name: vg-brain-capture
description: VG Brain automatic session capture. RESTRICTED ADD-ON, install only if you have been told to. Adds back the background hooks that upload every Claude Code session to your own VG Brain notes at session end, before a compact, and on catch-up after a missed upload. The base vg-brain plugin does NOT capture anything; this is the only component that does. Install alongside vg-brain, never instead of it.
